_purpose: Business rules and validations implied by the design PDFs. Test cases trace to these ids; negative and boundary cases are derived from them.

_basis_legend.explicit: stated in the PDF text or visible in a screenshot
_basis_legend.verified: observed in the running app by QA (existing KB)
_basis_legend.inferred: reasonable implication of the design; confirm with the business before asserting it as a hard pass/fail

_scope: SAMPLE CYCLE: authentication (OTP) and organization selection.

rules.statement: OTP sign-in only proceeds for a username/email associated with a B2B customer. An unassociated identifier keeps the user on the Login screen with the inline error.
Submitting a registered identifier issues one OTP to BOTH the registered e-mail and mobile number, and the entry screen shows both destinations masked.
rules.message: We have sent the OTP to your E-mail and Mobile number

rules.statement: The OTP is exactly 6 numeric digits entered one per box; verification cannot complete with fewer.
rules.source: Sign-in using OTP.pdf p1; existing KB

rules.statement: A wrong or expired OTP is rejected with an error dialog; OKAY returns the user to OTP entry without ending the attempt.
The user can request a new OTP via Resend. Invalidation of the previous OTP and any resend throttling are not specified.
rules.open_question: Does Resend invalidate the earlier OTP? Is there a cooldown or attempt limit?

rules.statement: After successful authentication: if the user has a default organization, that organization's Dashboard opens directly; if not, Select a Organization to continue is shown.
rules.source: Sign-in using OTP.pdf p2; Sign-in using Password.pdf p1; Sign-in using UAE Pass.pdf p3-4

rules.statement: Three sign-in methods exist -- OTP, e& Password, UAE PASS -- and all converge on the same post-authentication step (BR-AUTH-06). Only OTP is verified in the running app.
rules.source: all sign-in PDFs; existing KB provenance

rules.statement: Sign Out (profile menu) ends the session and returns to Login; protected routes are then unreachable without signing in again.
OTP destinations are displayed masked: e-mail keeps its first character and domain initial; mobile keeps its first digit and last two digits.
Clicking an organization card opens the Organization Dashboard scoped to that organization's accounts.
Each organization card shows name, the user's role in it, Trade License No, a status badge and the count of cost centres (Party IDs).
The cost-centre link opens a list of that organization's Party IDs; the heading count equals the number of tiles and the number on the card.
Selection of a non-ACTIVE organization is not shown in the PDFs; behaviour for suspended/inactive organizations is unspecified.
rules.open_question: Are non-ACTIVE organizations listed, and are they selectable?

rules.statement: Dashboard widgets show an explicit empty state when there is no data: TOTAL DUE 'No pending dues.', ORDERS 'You don't have any orders yet to track.', SUPPORT TICKETS 'You don't have any support tickets yet to track.'
ORDERS and SUPPORT TICKETS widgets cover the last 30 days.
The ACCOUNTS donut total equals the 'N Active' count and the sum of per-category rows.
rules.source: Sign-in using OTP.pdf p2 (2 Active / donut 2 / Internet and Data 2)

rules.statement: Cancelling on Approve Login Request ends the sign-in: the portal's UAE PASS Authentication page shows 'User Cancelled the login' with Sign in with UAE PASS and BACK TO LOGIN PAGE.
Password sign-in uses the Username and password shared with the user during the registration process.
